timeline: If you asked about Flight 370, this Boeing 777 vanished with 239 people in 2014 without sending a single distress call. How?
Thirty-eight minutes after takeoff over the South China Sea, voice contact stopped completely.
Minutes later, the aircraft vanished from air traffic control radar screens.
But military radar tracked the ghostly aircraft making a sharp western turn across the Malay Peninsula.
Satellite data revealed it flew for hours southward into the remote southern Indian Ocean until fuel ran out.
